26 Years of Dhadkan | Dil Ne Yeh Kaha Hai Dil Se – 8K Song
Relive the magic of one of Bollywood’s most iconic romantic songs!
“Dil Ne Yeh Kaha Hai Dil Se” from the timeless classic Dhadkan celebrates 26 years of love, music & unforgettable memories.
Starring Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty & Shilpa Shetty, this evergreen romantic track continues to capture hearts even after 26 years.
Song : Dil Ne Yeh Kaha Hain Dil Se
Singers : Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik & Kumar Sanu
Music : Nadeem - Shravan
Lyrics : Sameer
